newsitem.title: CHINA: China Shougang saves 300 mln yuan in Jan-Sept.
newsitem.headline: China Shougang saves 300 mln yuan in Jan-Sept.

text.p: China's Capital and Steel Co (Shougang) has cut production costs in the first nine months by adopting new accounting methods and strengthening checks on costs, official media said on Wednesday.
The steel giant has reduced its production costs by 300 million yuan compared with the same period a year ago, the Capital Economic Information Daily said.
Shougang has introduced new accounting practices to reflect market conditions and limit production costs in recent months. It had also strengthened checks on costs, the newspaper said.
The company has made various technical improvements to cut its energy consumption levels in key projects and adopted advanced technology to expand the lifespan of steel furnaces, it added.
